saira: heads-up — ran a long-context soak on nova-encoder-30b-int4 (16k+ ctx) and hit intermittent token divergence that looks like kvcache race/corruption. repro ~2/30 runs. anyone available to eyeball logs? :thinking:

ben: can you paste the minimal repro and exact command? was this on dedicated or local bench?

saira: dedicated pool d-gpu-b4. command: `python -m tests.longctx_kv --model nova-encoder-30b-int4 --steps 18000 --seed 42 --batch 4`

saira: stderr excerpt:
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] kvcache: append shard=2 pos=16382 len=4
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] kvcache: writeback started token=16384
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] attention: rope-scale=linear on
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] model: quant=int4
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] ERROR: kv-checksum mismatch at global_pos=16384 expected=0x7f got=0x1a
[2026-02-12 09:12:15] trace: shard=2 thread=worker-7 last_write_ts=167..

oliver: looks like a stale write overlapping with prefetch. try REDWOOD_KV_LOCK=1 or KV_WRITE_PARALLELISM=1?

saira: re-ran with REDWOOD_KV_LOCK=1 — 0/6 failures so far (was 2/6). running more.

jamal: try `--no-prefill` and `--prefill-only` to isolate prefill vs streaming writes. also capture kv-dump on error: `REDWOOD_DUMP_KV_ON_ERROR=1`

saira: dump uploaded: /tmp/kv-dump-1808881234-1.bin — shows overlapping entries around 0x3f00..0x4100.

eva: int4 packing might change alignment; any parity-check tool to validate per-token checksums and RoPE continuity?

jamal: `tools/kv_inspect.py --dump ... --check-rope` flags sudden rotary phase discontinuities that indicate offset writes.

oliver: enable `ROPE_SHIFT_DEBUG=1` to log pos->phase mapping. if phase jumps, it's a write-shift not attention math.

saira: quick matrix results: int8 + parallelism=4 -> 0/20 failures; int4 + parallelism=4 -> 3/20; int4 + parallelism=1 -> 0/20.

ben: strong signal for race in int4 write path. int4 packing likely increases small-grain writes, leading to interleaving. please prepare a minimal reproducer toggling quant+parallelism and attach kv-dumps.

saira: trimming to a 2k-step repro and adding pre/post kv dumps. initial diffs show token substitutions near tail — coherent but unacceptable for quality-sensitive workflows.

ci-bot: build 1245 for branch feature/kv-lock-probe completed — unit tests passed :white_check_mark:

jamal: if you can reproduce fast, run an ASAN-enabled build to catch invalid memory or ordering; also I'll run a microbench that repeatedly writes small kv records to stress alignment.

saira: one more oddity: `--rope-scale none` reduced repro rate (3/20 -> 1/20) even with int4+parallelism=4. suggests RoPE scaling interacts with write ordering.

oliver: plausible — RoPE phase multiplication touches kv buffers; concurrent int4 packing could interleave bytes so phase factors get mixed. heavy instrumentation needed.

eva: for evals: do we have a golden long-context LLMQA to measure downstream impact?

saira: comparing failing run to int8 single-threaded golden: token-level diffs localized near tail. not catastrophic today but could break RL pipeline.

ben: open a ticket with dumps, repro, and matrix. tag infra/runtime and eng-ml, assign to oliver/jamal.

saira: filed INF-3892 "intermittent KV write overlap with int4 packing under parallel writes affecting RoPE phase" — attached logs, dumps, repro. pinging @oliver @jamal.

oliver: I'll bisect between quant kernels and KV writer changes. jamal — please include rope-shift traces in next run.

jamal: on it. will also run a focused alignment stress test.

saira: thanks team, will update INF-3892 with overnight results. :rocket:
